integrationReview.reason: SYSTEM.md documents auth-microservice as providing optional API and queue authentication, configured via `AUTH_SERVICE_URL` in .env.example.
integrationReview.failureMode: When auth is not configured or unavailable, API endpoints operate per the documented optional-auth mode; this must not silently bypass authorization where it is enabled.
integrationReview.validation: Auth-enabled route smoke checks when AUTH_SERVICE_URL is configured.

integrationReview.reason: `.env.example` declares optional DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME variables, but no code in server.js references them; the service currently runs entirely on the in-memory/disk-backed sample dataset without a mandatory PostgreSQL dependency.
No Redis client, environment variable, or documented usage exists anywhere in this repository.
SYSTEM.md and .env.example document LOGGING_SERVICE_URL as the central event/log collection endpoint used for every pipeline step and the web UI's per-email log viewer.
integrationReview.contract: Structured event/log delivery per pipeline step via LOGGING_SERVICE_URL
integrationReview.failureMode: Logging outage degrades the web UI's log viewer and central observability; local LOG_DIR and in-memory logs remain available as documented fallback.
integrationReview.validation: Structured log delivery checks and the web UI 'See logs...' viewer.

integrationReview.reason: SYSTEM.md documents notifications-microservice as an optional integration via NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL in .env.example for triage-related notifications.
integrationReview.failureMode: Notification failures degrade operator awareness without blocking the core triage pipeline.
integrationReview.validation: Notification dispatch smoke checks when configured.

integrationReview.reason: This is the core dependency: classify/extract/decide proxy directly to ai-microservice via AI_SERVICE_URL, per README.md and BUSINESS.md's explicit reuse constraint.
integrationReview.contract: Proxied AI execution calls for classify/extract/decide per the documented email-triage contracts
integrationReview.failureMode: AI service outage blocks classify/extract/decide stages and falls back to rule-based classification/decision per the documented model_used behavior.
integrationReview.validation: Endpoint tests (scripts/test-email-triage-endpoints.js) and Sync B/C/D validation docs.

AGENTS.md already directs agents to use docs-rag-microservice for bounded discovery on this repository, with Git as the authoritative fallback.
integrationReview.contract: Direct Git repository ingestion and repository-scoped retrieval
integrationReview.configuration: Tracked in the canonical repository registry and docs-RAG index
integrationReview.failureMode: When docs-RAG is unavailable, Git remains authoritative per AGENTS.md.
integrationReview.validation: Repository documents resolve to the owning repository path and remain discoverable.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and rollout readiness must be observable through the shared monitoring model, consistent with the documented `GET /health` deploy-script check.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health and Kubernetes readiness checks for rollout control
integrationReview.configuration: Deployment probes and health endpoint in deploy.config.sh / k8s manifests

integrationReview.reason: The service holds no durable database (PostgreSQL usage is optional and currently unused); the sample dataset is a versioned repository file, not a production data store requiring backup.
